scope: Pixel-level color-role responsiveness of the separate native QtQuick5 ToolTip used for disabled controls, using the same disabled button and hint text under four KDE color schemes.

runtime.profiles: One disposable HOME, kdeglobals, color-schemes directory and private D-Bus/network namespace per scheme

method.control: Native disabled QtQuick Button, unchanged text, same position and 750 ms hint delay
method.capture: QQuickWindow screenshot while the separate ToolTip was visible; pixel regions sampled inside the popup away from its text and rounded edge
method.interpretation: Values below are measured pixels from isolated previews, not constants added to source code.

conclusion: Popup fill and text pixels changed with the active scheme; the native style supplied contrasting light/dark text and background. No final colors were inserted into the QML, and the source scheme files were only read.
limitations: One disabled button/layout was sampled; other controls and tooltip positions were not sampled across all four schemes.
QtQuick6 full matrix passed under DomainOS in R130, but this palette capture was QtQuick5 only.
Color change demonstrates scheme responsiveness, not full WCAG contrast or pixel fidelity to historical HP VUE.
next: Repeat the focused popup color check in QtQuick6, then continue T07's remaining controls, layouts and manual review.
